name: Morse.pathTangent
why: Project: the submodule of fields X piecewise smooth on [0,1], with prj (c t) (X t) = X t on [0,1], X 0 = X 1 = 0. Blind: the span of the fields piecewise smooth (subdivision form) with X t in the span-of-velocities tangent space at c t, vanishing at 0 and 1. At c t in N, prj x v = v iff v in tangentSubspace = blind tangent space; at c t not in N both force X t = 0 (prj = 0, blind space = bot). So the generating set is the project's carrier and its span is itself; equal for every c (no c in Omega needed).
